description: MecCog extension to the RRGI/MIRA draft lexicons (tech.scios.rrgi.*). Embedded objects carried on base records: #finding on tech.scios.rrgi.evidence (key `meccogFinding`), #source on tech.scios.rrgi.source (key `meccogSource`), #hypothesis on tech.scios.rrgi.claim (key `meccogHypothesis`). They hold what the MecCog challenge sheet needs and the base lexicons have no field for: reported statistics with provenance codes, directness of evidence, and the perturbed/measured mapping to the hypothesis variables. Base-record fields stay authoritative where they exist (evidence.text, evidence.description, provenance.excerpt). Decimals are strings, since DAG-CBOR has no floats. Status: draft, 2026-11-17.

finding.description: One experimental finding as the MecCog challenge records it, beyond what tech.scios.rrgi.evidence carries.

hypothesis.description: MecCog hypothesis id, e.g. 'H1'. The finding's supports/opposes edges point at that hypothesis's claim record.

extractionOrder.description: Position of the finding in its paper's extraction; a stable tiebreak for ordering.

summary.description: Structured notation used to match findings across submissions, e.g. '(APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lower endosomal pH in astrocytes)'.

relevance.description: 0 to 1, as a decimal string: how much the finding bears on the hypothesis.

dataLocation.description: Where in the paper, at panel level: 'Fig 4C', 'Table 2', 'Supplementary Fig 3B'. The panels are also tech.scios.rrgi.entity records linked by observationBase.

effectSize.description: As the paper reports it: '40%', '2.5x', 'd=3.7', a leading '~' when estimated from a figure, 'qualitative', or 'N/A'.

pValue.description: A number or an inequality ('<0.001'), or 'N/A'. Never estimated.

sampleSize.description: A whole number or a range as printed ('8-12'), '~n' when counted off a figure, or 'N/A'.

directnessClass.description: How the experiment lines up with 'a change in A causes a change in B': 1 direct, 2 indirect input (surrogate A'), 3 indirect output (surrogate B'), 4 both, 5 other. Relative to the hypothesis, not the paper.

directnessStrength.description: d, 1 very strong to 5 very weak: how misleading the surrogates could be. Also projected onto the edge's relationStrength (1-2 strong, 3 moderate, 4-5 weak).

direction.description: Drives the edge: supports -> supports; contradicts and no_effect -> opposes; mixed -> both.

perturbed.description: What the experiment varied, mapped to the hypothesis: A or A_surrogate (or other). Its ontology terms are in evidence.contextEntities.

measured.description: What the experiment measured: B, B_surrogate, intermediate, or other.

audit.description: The automatic checks against the source. Set status to 'kept' or 'dropped' by hand to override; the sheet and the supports/opposes edges follow it.

quoteCoverage.description: Share of the quote found verbatim in the PDF text layer, 0 to 1, or 'N/A'.

source.description: What the MecCog sheet needs about a paper beyond tech.scios.rrgi.source.
